decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with through contacts are a strategic offering and no performance issues are indicated.
Carrier wafers support the firm's wafer processing line and are likely retained as a complementary product.
Copper interposer glass wafers address advanced packaging demand and remain a promising product with no sign of failure.
The off-the-shelf brand Wafer Universe serves a stable catalog market and is unlikely to be discontinued.
Glass-based circuit boards are an emerging application that may need more time, but no evidence suggests immediate withdrawal.
